// @env node
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { register } from 'node:module'
import process from 'node:process'

async function main() {
  register('./deny-builtins.mjs', import.meta.url)
  await assert.rejects(import('node:process'), /核心入口不能加载 Node 内建模块/u)

  const core = await import('argvia')
  assert.equal('runMain' in core, false)
  const command = core.defineCommand({
    options: {
      verbose: core.option.boolean(),
      force: core.option.boolean({ default: false }),
    },
    run: context => context.options,
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(command, { argv: [] }), {
    kind: 'executed',
    value: { verbose: undefined, force: false },
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await core.run(command, { argv: ['--verbose'] }), {
    kind: 'executed',
    value: { verbose: true, force: false },
  })
  await assert.rejects(import('argvia/dist/index.js'), { code: 'ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED' })
  process.stdout.write('核心入口消费通过\n')
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error)
  process.exitCode = 1
})
